gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Noto Sans Coptic keeps its middle zone dense and its s and c mouths uncrowded, so lines look tidy and modern. Joystix is the one with arcade punch; this one just reads.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-cuneifor: Widely tracked arcade lettering, with stems barely heavier than the arms between them. Noto Sans Cuneiform follows with puffed-up lowercase and an e that stays open, and that bubbly softness against the compact heading is what makes the pair.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-devanaga: Noto Sans Devanagari reads neutral and modern, with a g whose lower curve stays open and capitals that melt into the lowercase. And Joystix, with its moderate thick-thin shift, can go big while the body stays at a modest size.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Duployan opens its lowercase a wide and gives its e and a oversized counters beneath a widely tracked Joystix heading. Shrink Joystix and the arcade swagger fades.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-elbasan: Noto Sans Elbasan reads large in the lowercase, with ascenders tucked close and terminals that never pinch shut. Yet Joystix handles the loud, restrained-stroke arcade statement, while the sans-serif body does the quiet, steady talking.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Bold arcade attitude comes from Joystix, whose crossbars run a touch slimmer than its stems and whose letters sit widely tracked. But Noto Sans Elymaic is the sturdy partner here, with open apertures and ascenders that barely rise above the x-height.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-georgian: Noto Sans Georgian brings open curves throughout and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, a modern, clean text face. And if the Joystix heading feels loud, the body can stay at a modest size without losing a thing.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-glagolit: Arcade attitude, spaced out wide. Noto Sans Glagolitic answers with sturdy, tall lowercase and open round letters that stay clear even small, which gives Joystix's restrained thick-thin rhythm a friendly, approachable partner.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Noto Sans Gothic reads modern, with lowercase counters as big as drilled glass beads and round forms like open parentheses. Yet Joystix does the shouting, its verticals just heavier than its horizontals, and the body does the quiet work.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-grantha: Noto Sans Grantha runs tall and little, like pen-nib bowls pressed flat, and never snags on a closed-up bowl. Joystix, with thin strokes just lighter than thick, is the headline voice, while Noto Sans Grantha is made for steady reading.
